patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kit and Klaviyo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Kit only if your buying job matches “Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digi” rather than Klaviyo's shape. Choose Klaviyo only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce email + SMS platform with Shopify-native flows, revenue attribution, and active-” rather than Kit's shape. Workflow advantage: Kit leans shared coverage; Klaviyo leans ecommerce-email. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kit and Klaviyo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Kit is Creator and newsletter ESP (formerly ConvertKit) with landing pages, automations, and digital product selling.; Klaviyo is Ecommerce email + SMS platform with Shopify-native flows, revenue attribution, and active-profile billing..
- Company-size focus: Kit (micro, small-business) vs Klaviyo (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Kit-leaning — vs Klaviyo-leaning ecommerce-email.
- Researched limits: Kit — Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro; Klaviyo — Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows.

Limitations — Kit: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro; Paid pricing scales with subscribers; Klaviyo: Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows; Exact paid-band dollars require the live pricing slider — floors are research estimates.

Poor-fit cases: Kit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Newsletter plan limits automations vs Creator/Pro · Klaviyo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows · Avoid Kit if you actually need Klaviyo's motion (Ecommerce email + SMS platform with Shopify-native flows, revenue attribution, a)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
